name: Session Flow
tagline: Six UX features for the Hermes Desktop session sidebar in one plain-ESM plugin
summary: Smooth line-by-line chat animation, Ctrl+Scroll session cycling, Firefox-style session groups, glass readability for the composer, sidebar-style content tabs, and full personalization — six features in one plugin, all live-configurable from a built-in settings page.
description:
Session Flow turns Hermes Desktop's session sidebar into something that *feels* like a real app:

1. **Line-by-line chat animation** — assistant answers cascade in instead of popping. Duration, stagger, easing, code/list options — all configurable.
2. **Ctrl+Scroll = session cycling** — hold a modifier and wheel through your active sessions; a HUD shows position and title. Zoom surfaces keep their own behaviour.
3. **Session pane with Firefox-style groups** — list or grid, groups collapse into a stack (spine/fanned/pill), optional auto-grouping by date/source/project folder. Drop a tab on a project header to move it. Live status icons (thinking / writing / tool / waiting / done / error). Search + quick filter bar. App quick-start row above the toolbar.
4. **Glass & readability** — optional frost for the input field and UI chips, with a soft accent-tinted gradient overlay that fades to transparent. Blur, saturation, opacity, gradient angle/strength, scopes, and a travelling glow ring — all configurable.
5. **Sidebar-style UI tabs** — content-area tabs become rounded chips like the sidebar session rows. Live session info from the sidebar: working sessions get the travelling glow ring on their tab.
6. **Personalization** — pick your own accent color, set a chat background (image or video, fit/dim/blur/scope), and choose the pane surface (native sidebar / chat / none).
notes: All 30 marketing images are reproducible from the HTML sources under docs/marketing/src/. Re-render with the included render.sh scripts. The 5-second Hyperframes animation shows the four key visual effects in one loop.
